anatomy_notes.source: Direct Time Stranger chr107 model and native 2.000000127-second chr107_bn01 Idle; four endpoint-exclusive samples.
anatomy_notes.bind_axis: Source eye_L/R meshes occupy Z+0.08..+0.12 near Y1.89; lip joints also project toward Z+0.10 while hair and wings extend toward negative Z. Camera azimuth 0 sees +Z, so Down is frontal, 270/90 are opposing profiles, 180 is rear, and diagonals interpolate.
anatomy_notes.face: Separate source eye meshes on a pale face; inspect native-size contrast and use only a source-bounded dark edge if needed.
anatomy_notes.silhouette: Preserve source hair, head, long arms and claws, chain, boots, and broad rear wings.
anatomy_notes.offsets: Source J_head, J_center, and anatomical J_hand_l/r markers.
anatomy_notes.ground: Native foot and toe bones descend near Y0.05, below wings and chain; per-frame contact at one fixed shadow row.
